card.name: The word right as adverb
card.fires_on: The word "right" (or "Right") used as an adverb of place or time, as in "right at home", "right here", "right now", "right after" and "right away". It also fires on sentence-initial "Right".

modes.label: Emphatic adverb
modes.description: "right" strengthens a place, time or sequence word that follows it.
